55571-whom-god-hath-joined-a-question-of.title: A Question of Marriage.
55571-whom-god-hath-joined-a-question-of.creator: Fergus Hume,
55571-whom-god-hath-joined-a-question-of.description: A book by Fergus Hume,. The Deity Called Fate XXVIII. The Question of Marriage XXX. In the Coils of the Serpent XXXII. What Made the Ball sae Fine? The Assaults of the Evil One XXXV. For my Child's Sake XXXVI. The Death of the First-born XXXVII. The Last Temptation XXXIX. "And Kissed again with Tears" XL.

arxiv-2110-00798.title: A Framework for Intuitionistic Grammar Logics Thanks: Work supported by the European Research Council (ERC) Consolidator Grant 771779 (DeciGUT). Affiliation: Computational Logic Group, Institute of Artificial Intelligence, Technische Universität Dresden, Germany
arxiv-2110-00798.creator: Tim S. Lyon
arxiv-2110-00798.description: Abstract We generalize intuitionistic tense logics to the multi-modal case by placing grammar logics on an intuitionistic footing. We provide axiomatizations for a class of base intuitionistic grammar logics as well as provide axiomatizations for extensions with combinations of seriality axioms and what we call intuitionistic path axioms .

arxiv-2110-05876.title: Label-Aware ranked Loss for robust People Counting using Automotive in-cabin Radar
arxiv-2110-05876.creator: Lorenzo Servadei ⋆∘ Huawei Sun ⋆∘ Julius Ott ⋆∘ Michael Stephan ⋆# Souvik Hazra ⋆ Thomas Stadelmayer ⋆# Daniela Sanchéz Lopera ⋆∘ Robert Wille † Avik Santra ⋆
arxiv-2110-05876.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Lorenzo Servadei ⋆∘ Huawei Sun ⋆∘ Julius Ott ⋆∘ Michael Stephan ⋆# Souvik Hazra ⋆ Thomas Stadelmayer ⋆# Daniela Sanchéz Lopera ⋆∘ Robert Wille † Avik Santra ⋆. In this paper, we introduce the Label-Aware Ranked loss, a novel metric loss function. Compared to the state-of-the-art Deep Metric Learning losses, this function takes advantage of the ranked ordering of the labels in regression problems.

arxiv-2306-06045.title: Global solution and blow-up for the SKT model in Population Dynamics
arxiv-2306-06045.creator: Ichraf Belkhamsa and Messaoud Souilah
arxiv-2306-06045.description: Abstract Abstract: In this paper, we prove the existence and uniqueness of the global solution to the reaction diffusion system SKT with homogeneous Newmann boundary conditions. We use the lower and upper solution method and its associated monotone iterations, where the reaction functions are locally Lipschitz.

arxiv-2311-01857.title: Cosmological dynamics and observational constraints on a viable f ⁡ ( Q ) f(Q) non-metric gravity model
arxiv-2311-01857.creator: A. Oliveros, Mario A. Acero
arxiv-2311-01857.description: Abstract Inspired by an exponential f ⁡ ( R ) f(R) gravity model studied in the literature, in this work we introduce a new and viable f ⁡ ( Q ) f(Q) gravity model, which can be represented as a perturbation of Λ \Lambda CDM.

arxiv-2401-06283.title: Complete 3 3 -term arithmetic progression free sets of small size in vector spaces and other abelian groups
arxiv-2401-06283.creator: Bence Csajbók, Zoltán Lóránt Nagy
arxiv-2401-06283.description: Abstract A subset S S of an abelian group G G is called 3 3 - AP \mathrm{AP} free if it does not contain a three term arithmetic progression. Moreover, S S is called complete 3 3 - AP \mathrm{AP} free, if it is maximal w.r.t. set inclusion.

arxiv-2404-00565.title: Leveraging Corpus Metadata to Detect Template-based Translation: An Exploratory Case Study of the Egyptian Arabic Wikipedia Edition
arxiv-2404-00565.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by . Wikipedia articles (content pages) are commonly used corpora in Natural Language Processing (NLP) research, especially in low-resource languages other than English. Yet, a few research studies have studied the three Arabic Wikipedia editions, Arabic Wikipedia (AR), Egyptian Arabic Wikipedia (ARZ), and Moroccan Arabic Wikipedia (ARY), and documented issues in the Egyptian Arabic Wikipedia edition regarding the massive automatic creation of its articles using template-based translation from English to Arabic without human involvement, overwhelming the Egyptian Arabic Wikipedia with articles that do not only

arxiv-2404-17987.title: Spectrum of Weighted Composition Operators Part X The spectrum and essential spectra of weighted automorphisms of the polydisc algebra.
arxiv-2404-17987.creator: Arkady Kitover, Mehmet Orhon
arxiv-2404-17987.description: Abstract . We investigate the spectrum and the essential spectra of weighted automorphisms of the polydisc algebra 𝔸 n \mathds{A}^{n} . In the case n = 2 n=2 we provide a detailed and, in most cases, complete description of these spectra. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 47B33; Secondary 47B48, 46B60 1.

arxiv-2502-05385.title: Magnon-phonon interactions from first principles
arxiv-2502-05385.creator: Khoa B. Le 1 , Ali Esquembre-Kučukalić 2 , Hsiao-Yi Chen 3 , Ivan Maliyov 1 , Yao Luo 1 , Jin-Jian Zhou 4 , Davide Sangalli 5 , Alejandro Molina-Sánchez 2 , Marco Bernardi 1
arxiv-2502-05385.description: Abstract Modeling spin-wave (magnon) dynamics in novel materials is important to advance spintronics and spin-based quantum technologies. The interactions between magnons and lattice vibrations (phonons) limit the length scale for magnon transport. However, quantifying these interactions remains challenging. Here we show many-body calculations of magnon-phonon (mag-ph) coupling based on the ab initio Bethe-Salpeter equation.

arxiv-2509-20408.title: A Theory of Multi-Agent Generative Flow Networks
arxiv-2509-20408.creator: Leo Maxime BrunswicHuawei Technologies Canada leo.maxime.brunswic@h-partners.com, Haozhi WangTianjin University wanghaozhi@tju.edu.cn Shuang LuoZhejiang University luoshuang@zju.edu.cn Jianye HAOHuawei Noah’s Ark Lab haojianye@huawei.com Amir RasouliHuawei Technologies Canada amir.rasouli@huawei.com
arxiv-2509-20408.description: Abstract Generative flow networks utilize a flow-matching loss to learn a stochastic policy for generating objects from a sequence of actions, such that the probability of generating a pattern can be proportional to the corresponding given reward. However, a theoretical framework for multi-agent generative flow networks (MA-GFlowNets) has not yet been proposed.

arxiv-2602-10924.title: Non-centred Bayesian inference for discrete-valued state-transition models: the Rippler algorithm
arxiv-2602-10924.creator: James Neill, Lloyd A. C. Chapman, Chris Jewell
arxiv-2602-10924.description: Abstract Stochastic state-transition models of infectious disease transmission can be used to deduce relevant drivers of transmission when fitted to data using statistically principled methods. Fitting this individual-level data requires inference on individuals’ unobserved disease statuses over time, which form a high-dimensional and highly correlated state space.

europmc-pmc6133005.title: Sedentary behaviour and risk of all-cause, cardiovascular and cancer mortality, and incident type 2 diabetes: a systematic review and dose response meta-analysis.
europmc-pmc6133005.creator: Patterson R, McNamara E, Tainio M, de Sá TH, Smith AD, Sharp SJ, Edwards P, Woodcock J, Brage S, Wijndaele K.
europmc-pmc6133005.description: Purpose To estimate the strength and shape of the dose-response relationship between sedentary behaviour and all-cause, cardiovascular disease (CVD) and cancer mortality, and incident type 2 diabetes (T2D), adjusted for physical activity (PA). Data Sources: Pubmed, Web of Knowle

pmc-10654474.title: A tale of two in stent restenosis in same patient: Surprising findings from optical coherence tomography
pmc-10654474.creator: Akshyaya Pradhan, Shubhajeet Roy, Gaurav Chaudhary, Pravesh Vishwakarma, Sharad Chandra, Md Al Hasibuzzaman
pmc-10654474.description: Key Clinical MessageThe morphology of in‐stent restenosis (ISR) in drug eluting stents varies greatly from that of bare metal stents. Optical coherence tomography (OCT) is a useful aid for identifying the nature of ISR and planning the treatment accordingly, which may be by intravascular lithotripsy, cutting balloon or Rotablator, which can be used upfront if OCT shows calcified neoatherosclerosis.

pmc-11350450.title: HelmetML: A dataset of helmet images for machine learning applications
pmc-11350450.creator: Kailas Patil, Rohini Jadhav, Yogesh Suryawanshi, Prawit Chumchu, Gaurav Khare, Tanishk Shinde
pmc-11350450.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The improper wearing or absence of helmets represents a significant contributing factor to fatal accidents in motorcycle driving. This dataset serves the purpose of detecting whether individuals have correctly or incorrectly worn helmets through camera-based analysis. The Helmet dataset has been curated, comprising a total of 28,736 images featuring various helmet types, including Full-Face, Half-Face, Modular, and Off-Road Helmets, in both correct and incorrect configurations.

pmc-11476684.title: HIPI: Spatially resolved multiplexed protein expression inferred from H&E WSIs
pmc-11476684.creator: Ron Zeira, Leon Anavy, Zohar Yakhini, Ehud Rivlin, Daniel Freedman, Jason A. Papin, Kamilla Naxerova, Jason A. Papin, Kamilla Naxerova, Jason A. Papin, Kamilla Naxerova
pmc-11476684.description: Solid tumors are characterized by complex interactions between the tumor, the immune system and the microenvironment. These interactions and intra-tumor variations have both diagnostic and prognostic significance and implications. However, quantifying the underlying processes in patient samples requires expensive and complicated molecular experiments.

pmc-11528473.title: A glycan biomarker predicts cognitive decline in amyloid- and tau-negative patients
pmc-11528473.creator: Robin Ziyue Zhou, Frida Duell, Michael Axenhus, Linus Jönsson, Bengt Winblad, Lars O Tjernberg, Sophia Schedin-Weiss
pmc-11528473.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Early detection of Alzheimer’s disease is vital for timely treatment. Existing biomarkers for Alzheimer’s disease reflect amyloid- and tau-related pathology, but it is unknown whether the disease can be detected before cerebral amyloidosis is observed. N-glycosylation has been suggested as an upstream regulator of both amyloid and tau pathology, and levels of the N-glycan structure bisecting N-acetylglucosamine (GlcNAc) correlate with tau in blood and CSF already at pre-clinical stages of the disease.

pmc-11642663.title: Effects of Supervised Rehabilitation on Psychosocial and Participation-Related Outcomes After Lumbar Spine Surgery: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-11642663.creator: Francesco Scandelli, Davide De Leo, Giorgia Marino, Emanuela De Martino, Delia Cannizzaro, Paola Adamo, Federico Temporiti, Yoshiharu Kawaguchi
pmc-11642663.description: Background/Objectives: Supervised rehabilitation has been reported to improve motor and functional outcomes after lumbar spine surgery. However, the effects of supervised rehabilitation on psychosocial and participation-related outcomes are still debated. This study aimed to systematically review the effects of supervised rehabilitation on psychosocial and participation-related outcomes in patients after lumbar spine surgery.

pmc-11691502.title: UNIQUE STRATEGIES AT CEDARS-SINAI TO SCREEN FOR AND ADDRESS SOCIAL DETERMINANTS OF HEALTH IN OLDER ADULTS
pmc-11691502.creator: Sonja Rosen, Emma Cohen, Katie Hren, Christina Harris, Krystal Green
pmc-11691502.description: To effectively address health disparities and bridge systemic gaps between health and social care, healthcare institutions must cohesively address shortcomings in identifying, supporting, and monitoring social determinants of health (SDoH) to better serve communities. In 2021, Cedars-Sinai, a Los Angeles urban Academic Medical Center, launched a robust strategy to address SDoH needs across health system settings.

pmc-12333890.title: Physical Injury and Psychological Impact: Understanding the High Risk of Depression on Older Adults with Recurrent Falls
pmc-12333890.creator: Asmaa Namoos, Nicholas Thomson, Carol Olson, Michel Aboutanos
pmc-12333890.description: Background:Falls among older adults significantly increase the risk of physical injuries, loss of independence, and social isolation, contributing to psychological conditions such as depression.Objective:This study explores the association between falls and the risk of developing depression among older adults, comparing psychological outcomes between those with initial and recurrent falls.

pmc-12468576.title: Multispectral Pulsed Photobiomodulation Enhances Re-Epithelialization via Keratinocyte Activation in Full-Thickness Skin Wounds
pmc-12468576.creator: Joo Hyun Kim, Delgerzul Baatar, Myung Jin Ban, Ji Won Son, Jihye Choi, Chan Hee Gil, Min-Kyu Kim, Sung Sik Hur, Jung Eun Kim, Yongsung Hwang, Elia Ranzato
pmc-12468576.description: Chronic wound healing is a complex and tightly regulated process requiring coordinated epithelial and stromal regeneration. Photobiomodulation (PBM) using low-level red light-emitting diode (LED) therapy has emerged as a non-invasive approach to enhancing skin repair. In this study, we evaluated the therapeutic efficacy of a pulsed, multi-wavelength LED system on full-thickness excisional wound healing in a normal murine model.

pmc-12650627.title: Deep Learning for Predicting Late-Onset Breast Cancer Metastasis: The Single-Hyperparameter Grid Search (SHGS) Strategy for Meta-Tuning a Deep Feed-Forward Neural Network
pmc-12650627.creator: Yijun Zhou, Om Arora-Jain, Xia Jiang
pmc-12650627.description: Background: While machine learning has advanced in medicine, its widespread use in clinical applications, especially in predicting breast cancer metastasis, is still limited. We have been dedicated to constructing a deep feed-forward neural network (DFNN) model to predict breast cancer metastasis n years in advance.

pmc-12651471.title: Aloe vera Adjunctive Therapy for Pediatric Oral Candidiasis: A Prospective Controlled Study on Microbial Clearance and Treatment Adherence
pmc-12651471.creator: Alexandru-Emilian Flondor, Irina-Georgeta Sufaru, Maria-Alexandra Martu, Vasilica Toma, Stefan-Lucian Burlea, Ioana Martu, Giuseppina Laganà
pmc-12651471.description: Background/Objectives: Oral candidiasis is frequently encountered in pediatric populations, particularly in infants and toddlers, where the development of immunity and inconsistent oral hygiene contribute to disease susceptibility. While topical antifungal agents remain the standard of care, treatment challenges persist, especially regarding adherence and recurrence.

pmc-12666110.title: Ultra-miniature and sensitive optical fiber-tip optomechanical resonant photoacoustic spectroscopy gas sensors
pmc-12666110.creator: Taige Li, Pengcheng Zhao, Peng Wang, Shangming Liu, Linhao Guo, Wei Jin, A Ping Zhang
pmc-12666110.description: Optomechanical resonator (OMR)-based photoacoustic spectroscopy (PAS) sensors have garnered significant attention for ultra-sensitive and selective trace-gas detection. However, it remains challenging for optomechanical resonant PAS (OMR-PAS) sensors to achieve both high sensitivity and miniature size for trace-gas detection with minimal consumption in space-constrained environments.

pmc-12709424.title: Markovian state models uncover casein kinase 1 dynamics that govern circadian period
pmc-12709424.creator: Clarisse Gravina Ricci, Jonathan M Philpott, Megan R Torgrimson, Alfred M Freeberg, Rajesh Narasimamurthy, Emilia Pécora de Barros, Rommie Amaro, David M Virshup, J Andrew McCammon, Carrie L Partch
pmc-12709424.description: SummaryCircadian rhythms in mammals are tightly regulated through phosphorylation of period (PER) proteins by casein kinase 1 (CK1, subtypes δ and ε). CK1 acts on at least two different regions of PER with opposing effects: phosphorylation of phosphodegron regions leads to PER degradation, whereas phosphorylation of the familial advanced sleep phase (FASP) region leads to PER stabilization.

pmc-13209857.title: Mechanisms and Applications of Manganese-Based Materials in Tumor Immunotherapy
pmc-13209857.creator: Xiaoqi Kong, Changyue Zhang, Haodong Hu, Ye Chen, Wenjuan Gao, Ruijiao Chen
pmc-13209857.description: Manganese-based nanomaterials have been novel multifunctional platforms in tumor immunotherapy because of their tunable multivalent states, biocompatibility, and multi-stimulus responsiveness. Current cancer treatments are insufficient and cause severe side effects; therefore, manganese-based nanomaterials are proposed in combination with immunotherapy to mitigate adverse effects.

pmc-13273629.title: “Doctor, if it were you, which would you choose?”: Navigating personal preference questions in anti‐amyloid immunotherapy selection
pmc-13273629.creator: Eric Dinnerstein
pmc-13273629.description: The approval of lecanemab and donanemab represents a watershed moment in Alzheimer Disease (AD) treatment, yet clinicians face a novel challenge: guiding patients through treatment selection when head‐to‐head comparative data are absent. When confronted with the question “What would you do if you were me?”, clinical providers must balance evidence‐based medicine with the therapeutic alliance.

pmc-13573387.title: Association of emerging anthropometric ratios with arterial stiffness risk measured by pulse wave velocity: insights from a middle-eastern population
pmc-13573387.creator: Mobina Imannezhad, Susan Darroudi, Maryam Saberi-Karimian, Habibollah Esmaily, Mohsen Moohebati, Simin Rashidian, Sara Ghazizadeh, Gordon A. Ferns, Majid Ghayour-Mobarhan, Maryam Alinezhad-Namaghi
pmc-13573387.description: BackgroundArterial stiffness (AS), a strong risk factor for atherosclerosis and coronary artery disease (CAD), is typically assessed using pulse wave velocity (PWV). This study takes a unique approach by exploring the relationship between novel anthropometric indices and AS in a large cohort study.
